description:
Easy BeeZy keeps a beauty professional's day in order. Check today's schedule, find free slots, look up a client and the services you offer, then book an appointment or move it to another time — without leaving the chat.

It works on the same calendar as the Easy BeeZy mobile app, so anything you do here appears on your phone straight away.

Cancelling an appointment is deliberately left out: a cancelled visit is a real person who will not be called back, so that stays in the app.

defaultPrompt: Find a free 90-minute slot this week
Book Anna for a manicure tomorrow at 2pm
